---
description: Debug and fix a TypeScript or runtime error
---

I have an error in my RiftCoach app. Please:

1. Read the error message carefully
2. Read the ACTUAL file content mentioned in the error (not from memory)
3. Explain what went wrong in simple English (like explaining to a non-tech person)
4. Use an analogy to help me understand
5. Show the exact file and line to change
6. Provide the complete fixed code block I can copy-paste
7. Explain what the fix does and why it works
8. Check: does this fix break any other file that imports from this one?

Remember:
- I am not tech savvy. Walk me through step by step.
- Fix ONLY what is broken — do not refactor working code.
- Do NOT change architecture decisions or cascade order.
- Show the diff before applying changes.
- Wild Rift MOBILE only — never LoL PC.
